highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.1 prevents partial glyph-atlas updates from reusing evicted glyph locations.

bullets.lead: Glyph-atlas generation recorded only for complete updates
bullets.detail: Ganesh and Graphite no longer treat a partial glyph-vector update as proof that all earlier atlas locations are current.
